verdict.rationale: Slack ships its own headless interfaces. The Web API lets programs query and change a workspace, chat.postMessage sends messages, webhook triggers start workflows from outside Slack, and the Slack CLI manages apps from the command line. None of the evidence shows these being run in CI or other non-interactive pipelines. missing for 10: documented CI/CD usage of the Slack CLI, non-interactive/token-based auth guidance for pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Slack Web API is an interface for querying information from and enacting change in a Slack workspace.
The Slack command-line interface (CLI) allows you to create and manage Slack apps from the command line.
Webhook triggers for workflows - How to start a workflow from outside of Slack.
Sends a message to a channel.
Send data to or query data from Slack using any of more than 200 methods.
